title: Niche freelancer marketplace
summary: A freelancer marketplace for a specific skill or industry.
whyTempting: Generic marketplaces are noisy and low quality.
whyItFails: Liquidity. Too few buyers and freelancers. Disintermediation. Repeat clients leave the platform. Big platforms. Upwork and Fiverr add categories.
whatWouldChange: Managed services where the platform guarantees outcomes.

attempts.outcome: Merged with oDesk, later phased out as Upwork

reasons.detail: Liquidity: Too few buyers and freelancers.
Disintermediation: Repeat clients leave the platform.
Big platforms: Upwork and Fiverr add categories.
